===Pokémon Adventures===
[[File:Thorton Argenta Adventures.png|thumb|230px|Argenta in [[Pokémon Adventures]]]]
Argenta first appears along with her fellow [[Frontier Brains]], [[Palmer]], [[Dahlia]], and [[Thorton]] in a meeting; afterward they go back to their facilities. Argenta, along with Palmer, is seen trying to investigate the communication system of the {{gdis|Battle Frontier|IV}} going down. After Thorton is defeated by {{adv|Platinum}}, she slaps him out of the temper tantrum he was throwing.

Later, at the [[Battle Hall]], Argenta faces Platinum in the final match. Her {{p|Dragonite}} proved powerful but was eventually defeated by [[Platinum's Froslass]].
